name: Inspire Tree
description: Registers the Inspire Tree JavaScript library (plus inspire-tree-dom and lodash) as Drupal asset libraries so other code can attach an interactive hierarchical tree UI.
library_dependencies: inspire-tree 6.0.1 (helion3/inspire-tree, MIT) — loaded from jsDelivr CDN or a local libraries/ copy
inspire-tree-dom 4.0.6 (helion3/inspire-tree-dom, MIT) — DOM renderer, loaded from jsDelivr CDN or local
lodash 4.17.21 (MIT) — loaded from jsDelivr CDN or local; also overrides core/underscore site-wide
project_description: Basic integration with the Inspire Tree library (a client-side tree/hierarchy UI) that allows drag-and-drop of elements in a tree. Right now it only provides basic library integration; the maintainer invites issues for further improvements such as fields or views.
